title: Ziyarat of Imam Musa Kazim
urduTitle: زیارت امام موسیٰ کاظم علیہ السلام
intro: The ziyarat of Imam Musa al-Kazim in the source collection, with its associated supplications before the separate salawat section.
description: Read Ziyarat of Imam Musa Kazim with arabic text and english meaning with available transliteration, recitation context and source references.

blocks.text:
First Form | Second form Shaikh Mufeed |

You may then stop in front of the holy tomb, making the kiblah direction to be between your shoulders, and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا ولِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ وَلِيِّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya waliyya allahi wabna waliyyihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s intimate servant and son of His intimate servant.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا حُجَّةَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ حُجَّتِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya hujjata allahi wabna hujjatihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s argument and son of His argument.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَفِيَّ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ صَفِيِّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya safiyya allahi wabna safiyyihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s choice and son of His choice.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا امِينَ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ امينِهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya amina allahi wabna aminihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s trustee and son of His trustee.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ ٱلارْضِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi fi zulumati al-ardi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O Allah’s light in the darkness of the earth.
Peace be upon you, O leader to the true guidance.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَلَمَ ٱلدِّينِ وَٱلتُّقَىٰ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O signpost of religiousness and piety.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَازِنَ عِلْمِ ٱلنَّبِيِّينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O keeper of the knowledge of the Prophets.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا خَازِنَ عِلْمِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O keeper of the knowledge of the Messengers.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نَائِبَ ٱلاوْصِيَاءِ ٱلسَّابِقِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O deputy of the preceding Successors (of the Prophets).
Peace be upon you, O essence of the manifest Revelation.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا صَاحِبَ ٱلْعِلْمِ ٱلْيَقِينِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O holder of the certain knowledge.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا عَيْبَةَ عِلْمِ ٱلْمُرْسَلِينَ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O case of the knowledge of the Messengers.
Peace be upon you, O righteous leader.
Peace be upon you, O ascetic leader.
Peace be upon you, O oft-worshipping leader.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ ايُّهَا ٱلإِمَامُ ٱلسَّيِّدُ ٱلرَّشِيدُ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O prudent leader and chief.
Peace be upon you, O slain and martyred.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ وَٱبْنَ وَصِيِّهِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka yabna rasuli allahi wabna wasiyyihi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger and son of his successor.

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا مَوْلاَيَ مُوسَىٰ بْنَ جَعْفَرٍ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya mawlaya musa bna ja`farin
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O my master Musa son of Ja`far.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.

blocks.arabic: اشْهَدُ انَّكَ قَدْ بَلَّغْتَ عَنِ ٱللَّهِ مَا حَمَّلَكَ
blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka qad ballaghta `an allahi ma hammalaka
blocks.english: I bear witness that you conveyed faithfully that which Allah ordered You to convey,
safeguarded that which He entrusted with you,
decided as lawful all that which Allah has deemed lawful,
decided as unlawful all that which Allah has deemed unlawful,
carried out the decrees of Allah,
recited the Book of Allah,

blocks.arabic: وَصَبَرْتَ عَلَىٰ ٱلاذَىٰ فِي جَنْبِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.transliteration: wa sabarta `ala al-adha fi janbi allahi
blocks.english: endured harm for the sake of Allah,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: and strove in the way of Allah as it ought to be striven
until death came upon you.
I also bear witness that you passed away

blocks.arabic: عَلَىٰ مَا مَضَىٰ عَلَيْهِ آبَاؤُكَ ٱلطَّاهِرُونَ
blocks.english: carrying the same principles on which your immaculate fathers
and pure forefathers
the successors, guides,
leaders, and rightly guided ones passed away.
You never preferred blindness to true guidance

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ تَمِلْ مِنْ حَقٍّ إِلَىٰ بَاطِلٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam tamil min haqqin ila batilin
blocks.english: and never slanted from right to wrong.
I also bear witness that you acted sincerely to Allah,
to His Messenger, and to the Commander of the Faithful,
fulfilled the trust,
avoided betrayal,
performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the evil,
and served Allah earnestly
and painstakingly, expecting His reward,
until death came upon you.
So, may Allah reward you on behalf of Islam and its people
with the best reward and the most honoring reward.

blocks.arabic: اتَيْتُكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ زَائِراً
blocks.english: I have come to you, O son of Allah’s Messenger, visiting you,
recognizing your right,
admitting your precedence,
knowing about your knowledgeability,
seeking shield with your inviolability,
seeking protection with your grave,
resorting to your tomb,
seeking your intercession with Allah,
declaring loyalty to your loyalists,
incurring the animosity of your enemies,
seeking insight of your standing
and true guidance you are leading to,
and having full acquaintance with the straying of those who dissent from you
and the blindness they are following.
Ransoms for you be my father, mother,
myself, my family members,
my property, and my sons.
O son of Allah’s Messenger,

blocks.arabic: اتَيْتُكَ مُتَقَرِّباً بِزِيَارَتِكَ إِِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ تَعَالَىٰ
blocks.transliteration: ataytuka mutaqarriban biziyaratika ila allahi ta`ala
blocks.english: I have come to you seeking nearness to Allah the All-exalted by visiting you
and seeking your intercession for me with Him;
So, (please) intercede for me with your Lord
so that He may forgive my sins,
pardon my offences,
overlook my evildoings,
erase my wrongdoings,
allow me to enter Paradise,
endue me with favors that suit His generosity,
and forgive me, my forefathers,
my brothers, my sister,
and all believing men and women
in the east and west of the earth,
out of His favoring, magnanimity, and benevolence.
Peace be upon you, O my master
Musa the son of Ja`far.
Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon you.
I bear witness that you are verily the guiding leader
and the guardian who leads to the right guidance,
you are verily the core of the Revelation,
the man of true interpretation,
the bearer of the Torah and the Gospel,
the knowledgeable, the decent,
the veracious, and the one who puts his knowledge in practice.

blocks.arabic: يَا مَوْلاَيَ انَا ابْرَا إِِلَىٰ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ اعْدَائِكَ
blocks.transliteration: ya mawlaya ana abra'u ila allahi min a`da'ika
blocks.english: O my master, I repudiate your enemies in the presence of Allah
and I seek nearness to Allah through loyalty to you.
So, may Allah bless you,

blocks.transliteration: wa `ala aba'ika wa ajdadika wa abna'ika
blocks.english: your fathers, your forefathers, your descendants,
your partisans, and your devotees.
May Allah’s mercy and blessings be upon them.

blocks.text:
You may then offer the two-unit prayer of ziyarah, reciting Surah Yasin (No. 36) –after Surah al-Fatihah in the first unit- and Surah al-Rahman (No. 55) –after Surah al-Fatihah in the second unit. You may also recite any> Surah instead. Then, you may pray Almighty Allah for whatever you need.

Second form

Shaykh al-Mufid, al-Shahid, and Muhammad ibn al-Mashhadi have said the following: If you intend to visit Imam al-Kazim (`a) in Baghdad, you may first bathe yourself with the intention of visiting him, direct to the holy shrine, stop at its gate, ask permission of entrance, and then enter there while saying the following words:

blocks.english: In the Name of Allah (I begin), in Allah (I trust),
on the way of Allah (I proceed),
and on the norm of the Messenger of Allah,
may Allah bless him and his Household,
and peace be upon the intimate servants of Allah.

blocks.text: You may then walk until you stop in front of the grave of Musa ibn Ja`far (`a). When you stop there, you may say the following words:

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا نُورَ ٱللَّهِ فِي ظُلُمَاتِ ٱلارْضِ
blocks.transliteration: alssalamu `alayka ya nura allahi fi zulumati al-ardi
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O light of Allah in the darkness of the earth.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s intimate servant.
Peace be upon you, O Allah’s argument.
Peace be upon you, O door to Allah.
I bear witness that you performed the prayers,
defrayed the poor-rate,
enjoined the right,
forbade the wrong,
recited the Book as it should be recited,

blocks.transliteration: wa jahadta fi allahi haqqa jihadihi
blocks.english: strove for the sake of Allah as exactly as strife should be,

blocks.arabic: وَصَبَرْتَ عَلَىٰ ٱلاذَىٰ فِي جَنْبِهِ مُحْتَسِباً
blocks.transliteration: wa sabarta `ala aladha fi janbihi muhtasiban
blocks.english: endured harm for His sake expecting His reward,
and served Him sincerely until death came upon you.

blocks.transliteration: ashhadu annaka awla billahi wa birasulihi
blocks.english: I bear witness that you are the closest to Allah and His Messenger

blocks.transliteration: wa annaka ibnu rasuli allahi haqqan
blocks.english: and you are verily the son of Allah’s Messenger.
I repudiate your enemies in the presence of Allah
and seek nearness to Allah through my loyalty to you.
I have come to you, O my master, recognizing your right,
declaring loyalty to your loyalists,
and incurring the animosity of your enemies;
so, (please) intercede for me with your Lord.

blocks.text: You may then throw yourself on the grave, kiss it, place both your cheeks on it, turn to the side of the Imam’s head, stop there, and say the following words:

blocks.arabic: اَلسَّلاَمُ عَلَيْكَ يَا بْنَ رَسُولِ ٱللَّهِ
blocks.english: Peace be upon you, O son of Allah’s Messenger.
I bear witness that you are veracious.
You fulfilled [your duty] sincerely,
spoke honestly,
and passed away as martyr.
You never preferred blindness to the true guidance

blocks.arabic: وَلَمْ تَمِلْ مِنْ حَقٍّ إِلَىٰ بَاطِلٍ
blocks.transliteration: wa lam tamil min haqqin ila batilin
blocks.english: and never slanted from right to wrong.
May Allah send blessings upon you,
upon your fathers, and upon your sons the immaculate.

blocks.text:
Post Ziarat Recitation

You may then kiss the grave and offer a two-unit prayer. After that, you may prostrate yourself and say the following dua:

blocks.english: O Allah, I have had recourse to You,
made my way to You,
hoped for Your favoring,

blocks.arabic: وَقَبْرَ إِِمَامِيَ ٱلَّذِي اوْجَبْتَ عَلَيَّ طَاعَتَهُ زُرْتُ
blocks.transliteration: wa qabra imamiya alladhi awjabta `alayya ta`atahu zurtu
blocks.english: visited the tomb of my Imam the obedience to whom You have made obligatory on me,
and I have chosen him as my means to You;
so, [I beseech You] in the name of their rights which You have made incumbent upon Yourself,

blocks.transliteration: ighfir li wa liwalidayya wa lilmu'minina
blocks.english: forgive me, my parents, and the believers,
O All-generous.

blocks.text: You may then put your right cheek on the ground and say the following :

blocks.english: O Allah, You have already known my requests;

blocks.arabic: فَصَلِّ عَلَىٰ مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِ مُحَمَّدٍ وَٱقْضِهَا
blocks.transliteration: fasalli `ala muhammadin wa ali muhammadin waqdiha
blocks.english: so, bless Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad and settle them for me.

blocks.text: You may then put your left cheek on the ground and say the following  words:

blocks.english: O Allah, You have certainly taken account of my sins;
so, [I beseech You] in the name of Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,
send blessings upon Muhammad and the Household of Muhammad,

blocks.arabic: وَٱغْفِرْهَا وَتَصَدَّقْ عَلَيَّ بِمَا انْتَ اهْلُهُ
blocks.transliteration: waghfirha wa tasaddaq `alayya bima anta ahluhu
blocks.english: forgive them, and grant me as charity that which suits You.

blocks.text: You may then return to the position of prostration and repeat the following word one hundred times:

blocks.english: Thanks.

blocks.text:
You may then raise your head from prostration and pray for whatever you wish and whomever you wish.

Recite the Salwaat at the shrine in next tab

Supplication For The Reappearance Of Imam Mahdi (A.S.)In The Shrine Of Imam Musa Bin Kazim (A.S.)- Sahifa Mahdi

blocks.arabic: أَللَّهمَّ عَظُمَ الْبَلاءُ، وَبَرِحَ الْخَفاءُ ، وَانْكَشَفَ الْغِطاءُ ،
blocks.english: “O’ Allah, the affliction is great, the concealment has evaded, and the veil is uncovered, and the hope has come to an end,
the Earth has become tightened and the Heaven has averted,

blocks.arabic: وَأَنْتَ يا رَبِّ الْمُسْتَعانُ ، وَ إِلَيْكَ يا رَبِّ الْمُشْتَكى .
blocks.english: You are the Helper and unto You we laid our complain.

blocks.arabic: أَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ عَلى مُحَمَّدٍ وَآلِهِ ، اَلَّذينَ فَرَضْتَ طاعَتَهُمْ ، وَعَرَّفْتَنا بِذلِكَ مَنْزِلَتَهُمْ ، وَفَرِّجْ عَنَّا كَرْبَنا قَريباً كَلَمْحِ الْبَصَرِ ، أَوْ هُوَ أَقْرَبُ ،
blocks.english: O’ Allah! Bless Mohammad and the family of Mohammad, the leader whose obedience You have made obligatory on us, and defined their rank to us, so relief us such a quick relief for their sake within twinkle of eye or even close than that,

blocks.arabic: يا أَبْصَرَ النَّاظِرينَ، وَيا أَسْمَعَ السَّامِعينَ، وَيا أَسْرَعَ الْحاسِبينَ، وَيا أَحْكَمَ الْحاكِمينَ .
blocks.english: O’ the most observant of all the observers, O’ the most hearing of all the hearers, O’ the quickest of all reckoners, O the most wise of all wise men,

blocks.arabic: يا مُحَمَّدُ يا عَلِيُّ، يا عَلِيُّ يا مُحَمَّدُ، يا مُصْطَفى يا مُرْتَضى، يا مُرْتَضى يا مُصْطَفى ، اُنْصُراني فَإِنَّكُما ناصِرايَ ، وَاكْفِياني فَإِنَّكُما كافِيايَ ، يا صاحِبَ الزَّمانِ ، اَلْغَوْثَ الْغَوْثَ الْغَوْثَ ، أَدْرِكْني أَدْرِكْني أَدْرِكْني ،
blocks.english: O’ Mohammad, O’ Ali, O’ Ali, O’ Mohammad, O’ Mustafa (the chosen one), O’ Murtaza (the satisfied one), O’ Murtaza, O’ Mustafa, help me, indeed both of You are worthy of that, suffice me, indeed both of You are worthy of that, O’ Master of time, relief, relief, relief, accept me, accept me, accept me.

urduGuidance: یہ صفحہ زیارت امام موسیٰ کاظم علیہ السلام کے لیے ہے۔ عربی متن اصل قراءت کے لیے ہے اور رومن تلفظ پڑھنے میں مدد دیتا ہے۔ انگریزی معنی الگ درج ہیں۔ ماخذ اور دوسری زیارات کے روابط صفحے کے آخر میں دیے گئے ہیں۔
